eligible_for: Candidates who are the first graduate in a family
Candidates attending counselling and joining professional courses

applicable_to: Self-Supporting courses in Government Aided Engineering Colleges
aicte_tuition_fee_waiver.other_fees: All other fees except tuition fee must be paid by the candidate

reservation_and_category_certificates: Government school study details from 6th to 12th standard for 7.5% Government School Students Reservation
Permanent Community Certificate for ST, SC, SCA, MBC&DNC, BC and BCM

differently_abled_persons: Medical Certificate obtained from Medical Board

counselling.participation: Candidates participate according to their rank

choice_filling.description: Candidates select and arrange their preferred colleges and branches in order of preference.

allotment.tentative_allotment: Candidates are provided a tentative seat allotment based on their choices and rank.
allotment.confirmation: Candidates must confirm the tentative allotment according to the prescribed procedure.
allotment.final_allotment: Final allotment is published after confirmation.

counselling_stages: Reporting to College/TFC and payment of fees

choice_filling.description: Candidates fill their preferred colleges and branches in order of preference.

confirmation_options: Decline and Move to Next Round

reporting.accept_and_join: Candidate must report to the allotted college and complete admission by paying the required fees.
reporting.accept_and_upward: Candidate must report to the nearest TFC, pay the required fees and wait for upward movement.

content.important_rule: Non-reporting or non-payment of required fees may result in cancellation of the allotment.

content.eligibility: Only Tamil Nadu Native candidates are eligible for Special Reservation
important_conditions: Candidates must produce appropriate certificates and supporting documents.
If required certificates and documents are not produced, the special reservation claim will not be considered.
Candidates under special reservation must also satisfy the general eligibility rules.
Candidates under special reservation are also eligible for admission under general counselling.

ex_servicemen: Certificate from the Department of Ex-servicemen's Welfare of Tamil Nadu
persons_with_benchmark_disabilities: Medical Certificate from the District Medical Board
Medical Board must consist of at least 3 doctors
eminent_sports_persons: Required forms specified in the brochure

requirements: As per Mines Act 1952, women cannot be employed in any part of a mine below ground.
In mines above ground, women cannot be employed except between 6 A.M. and 7 P.M.
As per Coal Mines Regulation 1957, women cannot descend or ascend a shaft in a cage or other means of conveyance unless accompanied by one or more adult males.
Candidates must satisfy the academic norms of Anna University.

content.eligibility_condition: Candidates must satisfy the eligibility conditions as on the last date of submission of the online application.

tamil_nadu_candidates: Candidates who have passed VIII, IX, X, XI and XII standard from schools situated in Tamil Nadu are eligible.
They need not produce a Nativity Certificate for verification.
tamil_nadu_native_outside_tamil_nadu_sch: Tamil Nadu native candidates who have passed any of VIII, IX, X, XI or XII standard from schools outside Tamil Nadu are eligible.
They must produce a digitally signed electronic Nativity Certificate.

central_government_employees_children.eligibility: Children of Central Government Employees can apply irrespective of native place.
central_government_employees_children.condition: Parent or guardian must have been serving continuously in Tamil Nadu for the past 5 years at the time of application.
central_government_employees_children.proof: Certificate from the employer of the parent or guardian.

public_sector_or_government_recognised_i.eligibility: Children of employees working in Tamil Nadu can apply irrespective of domicile.
public_sector_or_government_recognised_i.condition: Parent must have been employed continuously in Tamil Nadu for the past 5 years.
proof: PF slips or other supporting evidence

all_india_service_tamil_nadu_cadre_offic.eligibility: Sons and daughters of All India Service officers belonging to Tamil Nadu cadre are eligible.

other_state_candidates.eligibility: Other State candidates who have studied VIII, IX, X, XI and XII standard in Tamil Nadu are eligible.
